title: fix: bound retry and polling delays

target.summary: Server-directed retry delays from Retry-After headers are clamped to DefaultMaxServerDelay (8 seconds). When a server requests a delay longer than 8 seconds, the client retries prematurely before the server-specified wait duration has elapsed.
notes: faulty statement clamping numeric Retry-After header to maxDelay
faulty statement clamping custom date Retry-After header to maxDelay
definition of parseRetryAfterHeader defaulting maxDelay to DefaultMaxServerDelay
initialization of RequestConfig setting MaxRetryDelay to DefaultMaxServerDelay
call site invoking WaitForDelay with retryDelay
definition of DefaultMaxServerDelay setting the 8-second ceiling
